module: Flowgraph node "Collection Marker" (repeat_instant, author BeamNG). Displays a colorable token in BeamNG colors (TSStatic art/shapes/collectible/s_collect_BNG.dae) with a PointLight, which floats and rotates at the position of the pos pin. Inputs: flow, reset (impulse that deletes the marker), pos (vec3), color (number 0-1 from orange to green, or color). Output: flow.
notes: Bug: the reset pin calls self:clearMarkers(), a method that does not exist in this file (only hideMarker exists): triggering reset raises a Lua error.
The registered object names are self.id..'marker' and self.id..'lighgt' (typo in the light's name, harmless).
The output pin flow is never written by this node.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

hideMarker.desc: Deletes the marker object and the light and sets the references back to nil.

_executionStopped.desc: Called when the graph stops: deletes the marker.

work.desc: On reset, calls self:clearMarkers(). On flow, creates the TSStatic and the PointLight if needed, then updates position (with sinusoidal vertical oscillation), rotation, instance color and light (radius 3).

destroy.desc: Called when the node is destroyed: deletes the marker.
